label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

findings.problem: [name] banner had Reject All, but keyboard focus started on the banner container and I needed three Tab presses to reach the Reject button.

After rejecting cookies, Tab went into an unnamed embedded field and a chat close button, then cycled forever through three rotating announcement-bar links (Free Shipping, Shop Now, Shop The Collection) and never reached the main navigation; the main menu items never got focus. Only the Skip to main content link got me out, and it is itself hard to find.

Category tile was a focusable div that did nothing on Enter; the real link was the next Tab stop, so one tile cost two stops and the first Enter appeared dead. Also the page did not visibly change after Enter, so I could not tell the navigation worked until I re-read it.

element.name: Sheets Softer & softer in the finest long-staple, 100% organic cotton. Shop Now

findings.problem: About 18 Tab stops of sort and filter controls (every sort option, 7 filter buttons, a hide-out-of-stock toggle) sit before the first product, and there is no skip link past them.

Image gallery buttons have names that leak template text such as {{Color:White}}, and about 10 gallery and video stops come before the colour options; the 36 colour swatches and the size list are each many separate Tab stops and only the End key let me skip through them.

element.name: White cotton bed sheet set styled on a modern bedroom bed with natural light {{Color:White}}

findings.problem: After pressing ADD TO BAG a bag panel with PROCEED TO CHECKOUT opened visually, but keyboard focus stayed on the ADD TO BAG button behind it; the next Tab went to page content, not into the panel. The checkout button was unreachable by keyboard, so I could not get to checkout.
